prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1057
Claimant:
Justin Anderson
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
September 16, 2023
Claim opened following a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. The claimant reports a shoulder injury and is
represented by counsel, who has requested that all contact go through their office.
September 26, 2023
Reviewed the policy record and confirmed the driver is named on the policy and the vehicle is listed as an insured
unit. Coverage is in force for the loss period.
December 7, 2023
Police report and two independent witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of impact. Photos
from the scene and the statement from the other driver are consistent with the accident occurring as described.
January 13, 2024
Vehicle inspection shows rear-end daamge consistent with the reported impact. A few older scratches appear on the
bumper cover, and it is not yet clear whether all of the damage came from this collision. Referred to the appraiser for
a closer review.
January 25, 2024
Claimant's account of the accident has remained the same in every conversation so far, including the initial call, the
reocrded statement and the follow-up through counsel. No prior injury to the same body area is known from the
claimant's history or the records requested to date.
March 24, 2024
Medical records received show the reported shoulder injury is plausible for a collision of this type. Treatment followed
a usual course of physical therapy and tapered off as the claimant improved.
April 11, 2024
Sopke with counsel regarding the treatment timeline and the outstanding records request. Counsel confirmed the
claimant's position and agreed to provide the remaining documentation.
April 21, 2024
File reviewed. Liability and coverage are established, and the injury is consistent with the mechanism of loss.
Remaining question is the extent of the vehicle damage attributable to this impact, which is being assessed by the
appraiser.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
